summary.t: A curled pastel mane and a striped horn.

text.t:
A large head, the mane cut in curls of several pastel colours, and a striped horn. The eyes are closed and the lashes are painted in black.

Each curl of the mane is built up layer by layer — one of the slowest pieces we make.

options.power.help.t: Batteries are not included. The mains version comes with a remote: on, off, dimmer, timer and a slow pulse.

options.engraving.help.t: A name, a date or a short phrase, burned into the wood. Leave it empty if you would rather not.
